children: The probability of the "Giants win by exactly 1-6 points" outcome in Polymarket's "Cardinals vs. Giants" market rose sharply from 14% one hour earlier to 46.5%, according to Catcher Predict monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 32.5 percentage point swing in the submarket, and users were advised to watch for the impact of breaking news.

title: Polymarket Giants Exact Win Margin Market Jumps to 46.5%
